name: gateway-larksuite
description: Outbound-only Lark / Feishu (飞书) custom-bot gateway. send POSTs a text, post (rich-text), or interactive-card message to a custom-bot webhook URL with optional HMAC-SHA256 signing.

credentials.name: lark_webhook_url
credentials.description: Lark / Feishu custom-bot webhook URL (https://open.feishu.cn/open-apis/bot/v2/hook/<id> or https://open.larksuite.com/open-apis/bot/v2/hook/<id>). Override with env COS_LARK_WEBHOOK_URL.

credentials.name: lark_secret
credentials.description: Optional shared secret for HMAC-SHA256 sign mode. When present every request includes timestamp + sign in the body. Override with env COS_LARK_SECRET.
